title: Darwaza e hussain pe sajda kiye baghair
body:
Darwaza e hussain pe sajda kiye baghair
banta nahi wali koi aisa kiye baghair
Darwaza e hussain pe sajda kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
1. Dafna na mujhko jald, ali honge muntazir
aye logo intezaar kisi ka kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
2. Nau(9) laakh sar jhuke hai tabassum ke saamne
asghar ne jung jeet li hamla kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
3. Abbas wo jari hai jo maidaan e jung mein
ladta hai baazuo'n pe bharosa kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
4. Ghasib fidak ka naak ragadta hi reh gaya
jannat mein hurr chala gaya tauba kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
5. Ashoor wale din ye mujhe maa ka hukm tha
ghar mein na aana khoon ka pursa kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
6. Allah keh raha hai tawalla nahi qubool
Zahra ke dushmano pe tabarra kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
7. Qaem na zulfiqaar rakhenge niyaam mein
Abbas ke kaleje ko thanda kiye baghair
<<DIVIDER>>
8. Taqleed mein hu mai bhi anees o dabeer
sajjad sher likhta hu charwa kiye baghair
Darwaza e hussain pe sajda kiye baghair
